items.title: R.C.H. Smith Interview, 1975-10-02
items.q: She always delighted in the fact that her brother Jack was so famous.

ctx.x: It's funny that she's never made more of a name for herself. She's not a pushy

kind of person and she would not require the roar of the crowd. She always delighted in the fact that her brother Jack was so famous. She always will tell you that their mother was the great musician in the family, the great teacher of them all. She was very proud of her brother Charlie Teagarden, the trumpet player. She had a brother that she called Cub. I believe his name was Clovis Teagarden. He went off to go straight in the business world at some point but he was apparently a pretty good drummer. So it was…
Well, who was with Ori when you were going out in your college days?
